correction: PARTIAL holds and the mobile gap is real. I found no mobile or Hub-side implementation the auditor missed. Their fixDefects line ('None seen') is wrong, though: the fix has two small fidelity regressions on web/desktop. (a) Multi-file file_change previews collapse to 4 changes. (b) Long commands stay truncated in the expanded panel after the full payload loads. The auditor also left out that live and replayed thread.activity-appended events still carry full payloads. That is outside the finding's window scope and low worth.
summary: The server side shipped in 36760bffd: bounded per-kind previews (8 KiB for tool rows, 64 KiB for other kinds) with payloadPreview {fullBytes}, orchestration.getActivityPayload (2 MiB cap, viewer/read policy) and migration 088, which re-projects legacy rows. The web/desktop client opts in and fetches on expand (a01ef8557). Both commits are in the Hub's vendored 7bc39eec3, and the Hub has no method allowlist that needs a change. The native mobile client never opts in, so the intended phone surface still gets full payloads, bounded only by the 1 MiB window budget. Within the fix, the preview levels cut arrays to 16 and then 4 items at the same step that strings shrink. A file_change touching 14 or more files with ordinary diffs therefore keeps only 4 changes, and the collapsed row shows 'Edited 4 files' with +/- totals for those 4. The expanded panel also re-derives only output and exitCode from the fetched payload, so commands longer than 2 KiB stay cut with an ellipsis.

evidence.note: Per-kind preview budgets and boundPayload/previewActivityPayload are implemented as the auditor described.
toSentActivityRows is applied before the 1 MiB byte budget, both for windows and for history pages.
activityPayloads is forwarded for get/subscribeThreadWindow, and getActivityPayload is registered.

Legacy re-projection: tool rows over 16,000 B go through capActivityData and projectActivityPayload. It is idempotent, recorded in ryco_compatibility_repairs and also re-run as a boot repair (Migrations.ts:547,749).

Web/desktop sets threadWindowActivityPayloads: 'preview'. The supervisor applies it to windows, activity history pages and stale recovery (packages/client-runtime/src/connection/supervision.ts:478-507,656).
The mobile supervisor config has no threadWindowActivityPayloads. rg finds no payloadPreview, getActivityPayload or outputPreviewActivityId anywhere in apps/mobile.
Mobile renders entry.output whole from the window payload when a row is opened. There is no on-demand fetch.

Fix defect (a). Level 2 is {512 chars, 16 items} and level 3 is {128 chars, 4 items}, so arrays shrink as strings shrink. I re-ran the same algorithm in node: a file_change with 12 changes and ~3 KB diffs lands at level 2 and keeps 12; with 14 or more changes it lands at level 3 and keeps 4.

changedFiles and changedFileStats come from the (preview) payload, capped at 12. The collapsed row's 'Edited N files' count and +/- summary therefore drop to 4 files' worth for large multi-file edits. Tests cover only a 2-change payload (activityPayloadPreview.test.ts:27-53).

Fix defect (b). deriveActivityPayloadOutput returns only output and exitCode. The panel's inputLine comes from workEntryRawCommand(workEntry), which is derived from the preview, so a command over 2048 chars stays cut with an ellipsis after the full payload loads. Before the fix it showed up to 16,000 chars.

Live and replayed thread events (thread.activity-appended) still carry full activity payloads. file_change diffs are exempt from the 16K cap. This is out of the finding's window scope; it is incremental cost only.
The window SQL still selects and JSON-decodes full payload_json for limit+1 rows, and all of them are previewed before the budget cut. This affects server CPU only, not wire size.
A minor additional caller reads 40 activities without preview, but only on a flagged Claude resume send. Negligible.

remaining: 1) Mobile, the main gap. apps/mobile/src/connection/environmentDriver.ts:629-636 does not set threadWindowActivityPayloads: 'preview', and mobile has no getActivityPayload fetch (threadActivityFold.ts:88-101 drops outputPreviewActivityId; ThreadActivityFoldRow.tsx:89-94 renders row.output directly). Mobile windows and history pages therefore still carry full tool output and diffs, up to the 1 MiB activity budget per window, over hosted relays and cellular links. 2) The fix defects listed in fixDefects. 3) Optional, low worth: live and replayed thread.activity-appended events still carry full payloads, including uncapped file_change diffs (orchestrationStreams.ts:937,965). 4) Optional, low worth: the server still reads and parses full payload_json for up to 201 rows per window or page and previews all of them before the budget cut (ProjectionSnapshotQuery.ts:2140-2164, 3881-3885, 4278-4282).
fixDefects: (a) Preview levels cut arrays in the same step that strings shrink (activityPayloadPreview.ts:55-62). A file_change whose changes do not fit at level 2 (512 chars, 16 items) drops to level 3 (128 chars, 4 items). In practice that means about 14 or more changed files with diffs of roughly 600 B or more, which I verified by simulating the exact algorithm. The web collapsed row then reads 'Edited 4 files' with +/- totals for only those 4 (MessagesTimeline.tsx:2892-2908; derivation at session-logic.ts:2008-2017,2108-2119). Before the fix it showed up to 12 files. The expanded panel never re-derives changedFiles or changedFileStats from the fetched payload. (b) WorkEntryExpandedPanel (MessagesTimeline.tsx:3075-3082) takes inputLine from the preview-derived work entry, and deriveActivityPayloadOutput (session-logic.ts:1829-1834) returns only output and exitCode. Commands over 2048 chars (heredocs, python -c scripts) therefore stay cut with an ellipsis even after the full payload loads; before the fix they showed up to the 16,000-char ingestion cap. Both are small display regressions, not correctness or security issues.
implementationSketch: Mobile: (1) Move the keyed query from apps/web/src/rpc/activityPayloadAtoms.ts into packages/client-runtime/src/rpc as makeActivityPayloadQuery({ resolveGetActivityPayload(environmentId) }), keeping stale Infinity, gc 2 min and max 16 entries. Web and mobile each pass their own ensureEnvironmentApi(...).orchestration.getActivityPayload. Mobile already uses defineKeyedQueryByKey in apps/mobile/src/rpc/projectFilesAtoms.ts. Keep deriveActivityPayloadOutput shared. (2) Add threadWindowActivityPayloads: 'preview' to the supervisor input in apps/mobile/src/connection/environmentDriver.ts (next to syncThreadWindowSnapshot, about line 633). (3) Carry outputPreviewActivityId on ActivityRow in threadActivityFold.ts toRow. (4) In ThreadActivityFoldRow.tsx, when the row is open and the id is set, watch the query: show the preview text with a small spinner, then the full output, with retry on error and a 'truncated' note when result.truncated. Tests: a threadActivityFold unit test for the id passthrough, and a row test with a mocked getActivityPayload. Fix (a): in activityPayloadPreview.ts previewLevels, shrink strings before arrays, for example [{s:base,a:64},{s:base/4,a:64},{s:base/16,a:64},{s:base/16,a:16},{s:base/16,a:4}], or never cut arrays below 12 items before the scalar shell. Optionally also re-derive changedFiles and changedFileStats from the fetched payload in the expanded panel. Add an activityPayloadPreview.test.ts case: a 20-file file_change with 2 KB diffs stays under 8 KiB and keeps at least 12 changes with path, additions and deletions. Fix (b): extend deriveActivityPayloadOutput to also return rawCommand/command (reuse session-logic's existing command-preview extractor) and the changed-file lists. Use them in WorkEntryExpandedPanel once loaded, and cover it with a long-command case in MessagesTimeline.browser.tsx (near the existing getActivityPayload test, about line 1206). Optional: preview live thread.activity-appended activities for preview-mode thread subscriptions. That means threading the mode into makeReplayableThreadStream and mapping event.payload.activity through previewActivityPayload with payloadPreview. It is low value because live rows are what the user is watching.
decisionReason: None of this touches the protocol, auth or E2EE. The getActivityPayload RPC and the preview flag already exist and are relay-agnostic, and mobile opting in reuses the shared supervisor flag, as AGENTS.md requires for shared sync policy. The preview-level and panel fixes are client and server display details.
